name: Darkfinger
description: Darkfinger is a peninsula that lies to the west of Sinkuun, bordering the Northern Coast and Bast, and it is cannibal country. Cannibal villages and camps dot it, and the largest, First Village in the far north, is home to the Meat Lord and his chiefs. Nomad goat herders also camp there, bonedog packs roam at night, river raptors nest there, and acid rain falls at times. An old library lies in ruins on the peninsula.
